from.place: Strict decomposition of the model-and-comparison proof into cohomological data and fixed-realization comparison.

title: The supplied etale model has the fixed-realization isomorphism with the pulled-back object.
statement: Let Z be any scheme and Λ a finite commutative ring. For a bounded complex K of fixed Λ-module sheaves on Z_proet, use the cohomology functors of [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Suppose that, for every integer q, there is a finite locally constant Λ-module sheaf G_q on Z_et [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant] and an isomorphism ν_Z^*(G_q) ≅ H^q(K), where ν_Z^* is the etale-to-proetale comparison of [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Then there exists a bounded complex D of Λ-module sheaves on Z_et, all of whose cohomology sheaves are finite locally constant, together with an isomorphism ν_Z^*(D) ≅ K in the derived category. The model is constructed by derived direct image of K; it is not an independently supplied complex.

proof.text: For each q the supplied G_q identifies H^q(K) with an object of the classical module-sheaf subcategory. Use the classical-sheaf equivalence to prove continuity, transport it across the supplied isomorphism, and bridge the standard and small derived-category cohomology functors by localization.

Choose a lower bound a and regard K as an object of D^+. The comparison unit is invertible. Classical derived equivalence therefore makes the derived comparison counit at K invertible. Set D = Rν_*(K) and use that counit as the actual derived comparison isomorphism.

The exact faithful comparison functor commutes with cohomology and reflects zero objects, so D has the same cohomological bounds as K. For each q its cohomology comparison and the supplied model yield ν^*H^q(D) ≅ ν^*G_q. Full faithfulness lifts this to H^q(D) ≅ G_q, and finite local constancy transports across this isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: lemma-compare-derived (Tag 09B1), lemma-compare-locally-constant-derived (Tag 099Z); corrected counit construction, with finite-lisse cohomology reflected by full faithfulness.

lean.statement:
theorem lisse_finite_level_etale_model_comparison
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Z) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K))
    (hcohom : ∀ q : ℤ, ∃ G : Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ),
      IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf G ∧
        Nonempty ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) Z).obj G ≅
          (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K)) :
    ∃ D : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)),
      (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
        IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj D)) ∧
      (∀ q : ℤ, IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj D)) ∧
      Nonempty ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) Z).mapDerivedCategory.obj D ≅ K)

statement_change.old_statement: The supplied etale model has the fixed-realization isomorphism with the pulled-back object. The conclusion is the displayed comparison clause of the parent statement.
statement_change.what: The old Lean declaration quantified over an arbitrary etale complex D with only bounded finite-lisse cohomology. No hypothesis related D to E, N, or the local marking isomorphisms. Taking E=N=0 and a nonzero bounded constant D over a nonempty scheme with nonzero finite coefficients disproves its conclusion. The old parent chose D=0 even when its actual pullback could be nonzero. Replace the invalid arbitrary-D comparison by a genuine derived descent theorem for the specified proetale complex K and its etale cohomology models. Adapt the sole parent to apply it to the inverse fixed realization of the actual pullback; the parent statement and target statements stay identical.

citers.note: Its unchanged model-existence statement follows by constructing K from the actual pullback, obtaining bounded lisse cohomology, applying the corrected descent theorem, and composing with the fixed-realization counit. This delivery adapts its proof and dependency route.

old_proof.text: Transport the local marking isomorphisms through exact scalar realization and bounded classical comparison; naturality under restriction lets them glue to the canonical fixed-realization comparison.
